div.p: Here you will learn what is sum-up
Subtraction is the process of finding the addition between two numbers by taking adding number into another.
When using a calculator, you enter the first number, press the plus (+) button, enter the second number, then press equals (=) to get the result.
It shows how much remains after adding one value into another.
Here you will find instructions about using the sum-up feature of JPS calculator

section.p: To sucessfully sum-up numbers, you must know what is sum-up
The results from Sum-up are displayed
You want to add 2 from 3 . The equation will look like 3+2=5. You enter 3 , press + , enter 2, press equlas

div.p: Here you will learn what is subtraction
Subtraction is the process of finding the difference between two numbers by taking one number away from another.
When using a calculator, you enter the first number, press the minus (–) button, enter the second number, then press equals (=) to get the result.
It shows how much remains after removing one value from another.
Here you will find instructions about using the subtraction feature of JPS calculator

section.p: To sucessfully subtract numbers, you must know what is subtraction
The results from subtractions are displayed
You want to subtract 2 from 3 . The equation will look like 3-2=1. You enter 3 , press - , enter 2, press equlas

div.p: Here you will learn what is division
Division is the process of splitting a number into equal parts.
When using a calculator, you enter the first number, press the divide (÷ or /) button, enter the second number, then press equals (=) to get the result.
It tells you how many times one number fits into another.
Here you will find instructions about using the division feature of JPS calculator

section.p: To sucessfully divide numbers, you must know what is division
The results from divisions are displayed
You want to divide 2 from 6. The equation will look like 6/2=3. You enter 6 , press / , enter 2, press equlas

div.p: Here you will learn what is multiplication
Multiplication is the process of adding a number to itself a certain number of times.
On a calculator, you enter the first number, press the multiply (× or *) button, enter the second number, then press equals (=) to get the result.
It shows the total when one number is repeated multiple times.
Here you will find instructions about using the multiply feature of JPS calculator

section.p: To sucessfully multiply numbers, you must know what is multiply
The results from multplications are displayed
You want to multiply 2 from 3 . The equation will look like 3*2=6. You enter 3 , press X , enter 2, press equlas
